\section{1. Objective}




Produce a polished video system for \textbf{TwinSight X500}, the flagship portfolio project.




The video system must prove, in the shortest possible time, that Alexander can operate as:




\begin{mdcode}
Bloque de codigo: text
Real-Time 3D Developer / Unity Technical Artist
Unity WebGL · C# · CAD-to-Realtime · Technical Visualization · Interactive 3D
\end{mdcode}




The video must not be a generic thesis presentation. It must be a recruiter-readable and technical-lead-readable demonstration of:




\begin{itemize}
\item final product quality;
\item Unity WebGL implementation;
\item runtime interaction;
\item technical UI;
\item CAD-to-realtime optimization;
\item real-time visualization modes;
\item evaluation evidence;
\item clarity of role and contribution.
\end{itemize}
